ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Modern Fittings Candidates (harness only)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
HARNESS ONLY. Never shipped, never on a player's list.
Carries the round-3 candidate art (Transient/modern_style_20261023/cand_r3) for the Modern faucet, sprinkler head and pipe span at FlowWorks' own texture paths. Loaded after FlowWorks, its loose textures win (last loaded wins), so a live capture shows the candidates in game. Proof: src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/northstar/modern_fittings_live.py (row CANDIDATES_SWAPPED_IN). Item MODERN_FITTINGS_PROBE_FAUCET_NEVER_SEEN.
